ci_support_linux_64_.yaml:
c_compiler:
- gcc
c_stdlib:
- sysroot
c_stdlib_version:
- '2.17'
channel_sources:
- conda-forge
channel_targets:
- conda-forge main
docker_image:
- quay.io/condaforge/linux-anvil-x86_64:alma10
ocaml_compiler:
- ocaml
ocaml_compiler_version:
- 5.4.0
target_platform:
- linux-64
name: ocaml-cppo
raw_meta_yaml:
context:
  build_number: 4
  name: ocaml-cppo
  version: "1.8.0"

  # ocaml_win-64 ships gcc_* and vs2022_* at the same version/build; name the track.
  c_toolchain: ${{ "" if unix else c_compiler ~ "_*" }}
  library: ${{ "Library/" if not unix else "" }}
  m2: ${{ "m2-" if not unix else "" }}
  sh: ${{ "sh" if unix else "bat" }}

package:
  name: ${{ name }}
  version: ${{ version }}

source:
  - url: https://github.com/ocaml-community/cppo/archive/v${{ version }}.tar.gz
    sha256: 6e62a8ee0217c9cc38d5860110eb18eb8d89c05c420353d298e1431fe8bac00f

build:
  number: ${{ build_number }}
  script: build.sh
  string: ${{ c_compiler ~ "_" if not unix }}h${{ hash }}_${{ build_number }}

requirements:
  build:
    - if: not unix and c_compiler == "gcc"
      then:
        - ${{ stdlib("m2w64_c") }}
      else:
        - ${{ stdlib("c") }}
    # vs2022: ocaml no longer brings MSVC; zig: links the bytecode exes
    - if: not unix and c_compiler != "gcc"
      then:
        - ${{ compiler("c") }}
    - ${{ m2 }}bash >=5.2
    - ${{ m2 }}file
    - ${{ m2 }}gawk
    - ${{ m2 }}grep
    - ocaml-dune
    - ${{ compiler("ocaml") }}
    - if: not unix
      then:
        - ocaml_${{ target_platform }} ${{ ocaml_compiler_version }}.* ${{ c_toolchain }}
    # _18: the cross tree ships a working build-arch toplevel, so no native ocaml
    - if: build_platform != target_platform and unix
      then:
        - 'ocaml_${{ target_platform }} ${{ ocaml_compiler_version }}.*[build_number=">=18"]'
    - if: build_platform != target_platform and not unix
      then:
        - ocaml_${{ build_platform }} ${{ ocaml_compiler_version }}.* gcc_*
    - ocamlbuild
    - if: not unix
      then:
        - ${{ m2 }}coreutils
  host:
    - ocaml ${{ ocaml_compiler_version }}.*
    - if: not unix
      then:
        - ocaml_${{ target_platform }} ${{ ocaml_compiler_version }}.* ${{ c_toolchain }}
    - if: build_platform != target_platform
      then:
        - ocamlbuild
  run_constraints:
    - if: not unix
      then:
        - ocaml_${{ target_platform }} ${{ ocaml_compiler_version }}.* ${{ c_toolchain }}

tests:
  # Package contents validation (strict)
  - package_contents:
      strict: true
      bin:
        - cppo
      files:
        - ${{ library }}doc/cppo/LICENSE.md
        - ${{ library }}doc/cppo/README.md
        - ${{ library }}lib/ocaml/cppo/*
        - ${{ library }}doc/cppo_ocamlbuild/LICENSE.md
        - ${{ library }}doc/cppo_ocamlbuild/README.md
        - ${{ library }}lib/ocaml/cppo_ocamlbuild/*
        # Tests artifacts
        - etc/conda/test-files/*

  # Python-based functional tests
  - script: |
      python testing/test-cppo-arch.py
      python testing/test-cppo-functional.py
    files:
      recipe:
        - testing/test_utils.py
        - testing/test-cppo-arch.py
        - testing/test-cppo-functional.py
    requirements:
      # build-platform python drives the target binary via qemu binfmt on cross
      # lanes (sparse riscv64/s390x subdirs lack python and file)
      build:
        - ${{ m2 }}file
        - python >=3.9

about:
  license: BSD-3-Clause
  license_file: LICENSE.md
  summary: C preprocessor for OCaml
  homepage: https://github.com/ocaml-community/cppo
  repository: https://github.com/ocaml-community/cppo

extra:
  recipe-maintainers:
    - MementoRC
